rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that can be imagined or thought of.

example.english: At such an outrageous price, is it really conceivable that anyone would buy it?
example.traditional: 咁離譜嘅價錢，真係諗得到有人會買咩？
example.jyutping: gam3 lei4 pou2 ge3 gaa3 cin2 zan1 hai6 nam2 dak1 dou2 jau5 jan4 wui5 maai5 me1

rows.note: Use this when you want to state more explicitly that something is imaginable, especially in careful or explanatory speech.

example.english: Is the result conceivable based on this information alone?
example.traditional: 單靠呢啲資料，可以想像到個結果嗎？
example.jyutping: daan1 kaau3 ni1 di1 zi1 liu6 ho2 ji5 soeng2 zoeng6 dou2 go3 git3 gwo2 maa3
